PRAGMA table_info(measurements)
PRAGMA table_info(shared_export)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM measurements GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY MAX(recorded_at) DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT session_id, MAX(recorded_at) as latest_from_measurements, COUNT(*) as count 
FROM measurements 
GROUP BY session_id 
ORDER BY latest_from_measurements DESC 
LIMIT 20

SELECT m.session_id, m.participant_id, m.condition, m.cognitive_score, m.reaction_ms, m.recorded_at, m.status, m.notes
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (session_id) session_id, participant_id, condition, cognitive_score, reaction_ms, recorded_at, status, notes
    FROM measurements
    ORDER BY session_id, recorded_at DESC
) m
ORDER BY m.recorded_at DESC

WITH latest_per_session AS (
    SELECT session_id, MAX(recorded_at) as max_rec
    FROM measurements
    GROUP BY session_id
)
SELECT m.*
FROM measurements m
JOIN latest_per_session l ON m.session_id = l.session_id AND m.recorded_at = l.max_rec
ORDER BY m.recorded_at DESC

VALUES ('partner university', $json_payload, datetime('now'))
FROM (
    SELECT json_group_array(json_format(p)) as json_payload
    FROM (
        SELECT
            '{"session_id": "' || session_id || '",
             "participant_id": "' || participant_id || '",
             "condition": "' || condition || '",
             "cognitive_score": ' || cognitive_score || ',
             "reaction_ms": ' || reaction_ms || ',
             "recorded_at": "' || recorded_at || '",
             "status": "' || status || '",
             "notes": "' || replace(replace(replace(nullif(coalesce(trim(replace(quotes(replace(replace(replace(nullif(coalesce(trim(n'(p'))))))))))))))))))))))) || '"}' as p
        FROM (
            WITH latest_per_session AS (
                SELECT session_id, MAX(recorded_at) as max_rec
                FROM measurements
                GROUP BY session_id
            )
            SELECT m.*
            FROM measurements m
            JOIN latest_per_session l ON m.session_id = l.session_id AND m.recorded_at = l.max_rec
            ORDER BY m.recorded_at DESC
        )
    )
)
